values: 被动地，自身在满足条件的敌人处召唤处刑台持续对其处刑。主动释放时，变形为锯轮碾压敌人，造成伤害和生命削减效果。

Passive. Aneva summons a guillotine beside an eligible enemy to execute them repeatedly.
Active. She transforms into a saw blade and rolls through enemies, dealing damage and reducing their max HP.

被动地，每当自身周围2格范围内的敌人被击倒，或受到相当于其初始最大生命值20%的生命削减时，在该敌人身旁召唤一个“处刑台”对其持续处刑，每1秒对目标造成60% + 6% ATK物理伤害，并嘲讽目标。“处刑台”具有5点生命值，每1秒或每次受到普通攻击时扣除1点生命值对同一名敌人单次连续处刑3秒后，永久降低其50%移动速度和30点攻击速度。正在被处刑的敌人再次被击倒时，则使当前“处刑台”恢复2点当前生命并提高等量生命上限，生命上限最多提高2点。
主动释放时，从战场边缘向敌人最密集的3格宽直线范围冲刺，对范围内的敌人造成620% + 60% ATK伤害并将其击倒，同时造成100% + 10% ATK生命削减，随后返回原位。释放技能期间处于无敌状态。

Passive. Whenever an enemy within 2 tiles of Aneva is knocked down or suffers max HP reduction equal to 20% of their initial max HP, she summons a guillotine beside them. The guillotine taunts the target and deals 60% + 6% ATK physical damage to them every 1s. It starts with 5 HP and loses 1 HP every 1s and each time it is hit by a normal attack. After executing the same target for 3s without interruption, it permanently reduces their movement speed by 50% and their ATK SPD by 30. If the target is knocked down again during execution, the guillotine recovers 2 HP and its max HP increases by the same amount. It can gain up to 2 max HP in total.
Active. Aneva charges from the edge of the battlefield along a 3-tile-wide line that passes through the most enemies. She deals 620% + 60% ATK damage to enemies in her path, knocks them down, and applies max HP reduction equal to 100% + 10% ATK. She then returns to her original position. Aneva is invincible while casting this skill.
主动释放时，造成伤害提升至630% + 60% ATK。
Increases damage dealt to 630% + 60% ATK when this skill is used actively.
主动释放时，造成伤害提升至640% + 60% ATK。
Increases damage dealt to 640% + 60% ATK when this skill is used actively.
主动释放时，造成伤害提升至650% + 60% ATK。
Increases damage dealt to 650% + 60% ATK when this skill is used actively.
主动释放时，造成伤害提升至660% + 60% ATK。
Increases damage dealt to 660% + 60% ATK when this skill is used actively.
使用链子穿刺目标并移动至其身旁，自身获得护盾并对目标造成伤害。
Aneva pierces the target with her chain and pulls herself to their side, gaining a shield and dealing damage to them.

向目标掷出链子并使自身获得500% ATK的链锯护盾，持续8秒，护盾存在期间每0.5秒对自身当前位置周围1格范围内的敌人造成50% ATK伤害。随后将自身拉到目标身旁将其击倒反复碾压，在此期间共造成120% ATK伤害，结束后再次踩踏目标，对目标周围一格范围内敌人造成220% + 20% ATK伤害。若落点周围1格范围内每有一名敌人，护盾值额外提高100% + 10% ATK。该技能优先选择周围敌人最多的敌方英雄作为目标，在首次释放时，改为选择最接近对称位置的敌方英雄。

Aneva throws a chain at the target and gains a 500% ATK chainsaw shield for 8s. While the shield lasts, she deals 50% ATK damage to enemies within 1 tile every 0.5s. She then pulls herself to the target, knocks them down, and runs them over repeatedly, dealing 120% ATK total damage. She finishes with a stomp that deals 220% + 20% ATK damage to the target and surrounding enemies within 1 tile. Each enemy within 1 tile of her landing spot increases the shield by 100% + 10% ATK. This skill prioritizes the enemy hero surrounded by the most other enemy units. On its first cast, it targets the enemy hero closest to Aneva's mirrored position instead.
碾压伤害提升至130% ATK，踩踏伤害提升至230% + 20% ATK。
Increases crushing damage to 130% ATK and stomp damage to 230% + 20% ATK.
碾压伤害提升至140% ATK，踩踏伤害提升至240% + 20% ATK。
Increases crushing damage to 140% ATK and stomp damage to 240% + 20% ATK.
碾压伤害提升至150% ATK，踩踏伤害提升至250% + 20% ATK。
Increases crushing damage to 150% ATK and stomp damage to 250% + 20% ATK.
旋转切割周围的敌人，造成伤害并降低其护甲。
Aneva spins and slashes nearby enemies, dealing damage and reducing their Phys DEF.
旋转身体使用锯轮进行多次切割，对自身当前位置周围1格范围内的敌人造成270% + 30% ATK伤害，并使目标的护甲降低20%，持续10秒，在此期间目标还会每秒流失85% ATK生命值。

Aneva spins, slashing several times with her saw blade. The attack deals 270% + 30% ATK damage to enemies within 1 tile and reduces their Phys DEF by 20% for 10s. During this time, they also lose 85% ATK HP per second.
每次切割伤害提升至280% + 30% ATK。
Increases the damage of each slash to 280% + 30% ATK.
每次切割伤害提升至290% + 30% ATK。
Increases the damage of each slash to 290% + 30% ATK.
每次切割伤害提升至300% + 30% ATK。
Increases the damage of each slash to 300% + 30% ATK.
战斗中，自身受到伤害降低16%，每召唤一个“处刑台”使受到的伤害额外降低2%，至多降低至24%。
Aneva takes 16% less damage during battle. Each guillotine she summons reduces her damage taken by a further 2%, up to a total reduction of 24%.
战斗中，自身受到伤害降低18%，每召唤一个“处刑台”使受到的伤害额外降低3%，至多降低至30%。
Aneva takes 18% less damage during battle. Each guillotine she summons reduces her damage taken by a further 3%, up to a total reduction of 30%.
战斗中，自身受到伤害降低20%，每召唤一个“处刑台”使受到的伤害额外降低4%，至多降低至36%。
Aneva takes 20% less damage during battle. Each guillotine she summons reduces her damage taken by a further 4%, up to a total reduction of 36%.
终极技能主动冲刺命中敌人后，使其对应的“处刑台”变为“高级处刑台”，额外造成生命流失效果。
When Aneva hits an enemy with her Ultimate's charge, she upgrades their guillotine to cause extra HP loss.
受到自身终极技能主动效果影响的敌人，现有及后续召唤的“处刑台”升级为“高级处刑台”。“高级处刑台”生命值上限和当前生命均变为10点，目标在处刑期间再次被击倒时，仍可恢复“高级处刑台”生命值，但不再提高生命上限。每1秒额外对目标造成70% ATK真实伤害，若目标为非首领敌人，在其被处刑期间，受愈降低40点，并暂时失去所有属性增益效果。

When Aneva's Ultimate applies its active effect to an enemy, she upgrades that enemy's current guillotine and any she summons for them afterward. An upgraded guillotine's current and max HP are both set to 10. If the target is knocked down again during execution, the guillotine can still recover HP, but its max HP no longer increases. It also deals an extra 70% ATK true damage to the target every 1s. While it executes a non-boss target, their Vitality is reduced by 40 and all their stat buffs are temporarily disabled.
“高级处刑台”每1秒造成的真实伤害提升至75% ATK。
Increases the true damage an upgraded guillotine deals every 1s to 75% ATK.
“高级处刑台”每1秒造成的真实伤害提升至80% ATK。
Increases the true damage an upgraded guillotine deals every 1s to 80% ATK.
每有一名敌方英雄被击败时，立即在其所在格子召唤一个“高级处刑台”消灭其躯体，并为自身提供其30%的基础属性，总共不超过自身对应初始属性的60%，并使“链刺破军”和“旋锯裂甲”造成伤害时额外附带实际伤害量20%的生命削减，每名敌方英雄被击败使该比例提升20%，至多附带40%的生命削减效果。

When an enemy hero is defeated, Aneva immediately summons an upgraded guillotine on their tile to destroy their body. She gains 30% of their basic stats. The total gained for each stat is capped at 60% of her own initial value for that stat. Rending Hook and Shredstorm also apply max HP reduction equal to 20% of the actual damage they deal. Each enemy hero defeated increases this ratio by 20%, up to a maximum max HP reduction of 40% of the actual damage dealt.
战斗开始时直接召唤“处刑台”，并强化首次“链刺破军”的技能效果。
Aneva summons a guillotine when a battle starts and enhances her first cast of Rending Hook.
战斗开始时选择最接近对称位置的敌方英雄，直接召唤一个“处刑台”对其展开处刑。首次释放“链刺破军”时，自身的链锯护盾获得强化，强化护盾持续期间自身受到伤害降低30%并获得霸体效果。

When a battle starts, Aneva summons a guillotine to execute the enemy hero closest to her mirrored position. The first time she casts Rending Hook, she gains an enhanced chainsaw shield. While it lasts, she takes 30% less damage and is unaffected.
